name: subscription-downgrade-activator-lambda
description: AWS Lambda function to activate scheduled subscription downgrades after the current billing period ends

scripts.package: npm run build && bestzip subscription-downgrade-activator.zip dist node_modules package.json
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name subscription-downgrade-activator --zip-file fileb://subscription-downgrade-activator.zip
